opentargets.name: Tetralogy of Fallot
opentargets.description: A congenital cardiac malformation comprising pulmonary stenosis, overriding aorta, ventricular septum defect, and right ventricular hypertrophy. The diagnosis of TOF is made if at least three of the four above mentioned features are present.

opentargets.name: fallot complex-intellectual disability-growth delay syndrome
opentargets.description: Fallot complex - intellectual deficit - growth delay is a rare disorder characterized by tetralogy of Fallot, minor facial anomalies, and severe intellectual deficiency and growth delay.

opentargets.name: congenital heart disease
opentargets.description: A heart disease that is present at birth. Representative examples include atrial septal defect, ventricular septal defect, tetralogy of Fallot, and patent foramen ovale.

opentargets.name: NKX2.5-related congenital, conduction and myopathic heart disease
opentargets.description: A heart disease that includes congenital heart defects, abnormal cardiac conduction or myopathy. Congenital heart defects consists of any heart disease that is present at birth. Representative examples include atrial septal defect, ventricular septal defect, tetralogy of Fallot, and hypoplastic left heart syndrome.
